name: s51-quality-gate-worktree-isolation
setup_commands: git init -q . && git -c user.name=kitbench -c user.email=kitbench@example.invalid commit -q --allow-empty -m init && git worktree add -q -b kitbench-wt wt
notes: A subagent in a git worktree edits a broken file. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR stays at the main checkout, so the verdict used to land in the main checkout's .hook-state and block (or clear) it. The result now lives in the worktree: the main session's stop is not blocked, a stop from inside the worktree is.
